meta_description:
44K likes, 262 comments - kisnadiamondjewellery on October 13, 2026: "The wait is finally over!

This festive season, KISNA Diamonds presents a celebration of love, happiness and togetherness with our new brand film, featuring Shahid Kapoor, Mira Rajput Kapoor and others.

Festivals make everything feel a little more special. From homes filled with laughter and heartfelt gifts to precious moments shared with loved ones, it's the little gestures that bring us closer and make memories last forever.

Adding a soulful touch to the celebration, the iconic melody of “Woh Kisna Hai” brings a beautiful sense of nostalgia and a special connection to KISNA.

Here's to celebrating every bond, every gesture and every moment that fills our lives with happiness.

Khushi Ke Har Pal Ke Liye, KISNA.

#KISNADiamonds #KhushiKeHarPalKeLiyeKISNA #CelebrateWithKISNA #ShahidAndMira #WohKisnaHai".
